tldr: North Node in House 1: growth through identity, body, autonomy, and direct self-authorship.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop identity, body, autonomy, and direct self-authorship. The South Node in House 7 shows the familiar life field: partnership, approval, clients, or other people's needs defining the self. The house axis describes where the growth has to become lived, not just understood. The practice is to meet life from the self first.
business: Growth becomes practical when the person chooses identity, body, autonomy, and direct self-authorship in the concrete house topics of daily life.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in House 7 can pull the person back toward partnership, approval, clients, or other people's needs defining the self.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node house names the growth field; South Node house names the familiar field. Requires accurate birth time for house placement.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
